caption: The drawing depicts a pair of curtains with a decorative valance and border. The curtains are primarily off-white or beige in color and consist of two large hanging panels, each bordered by vertical strips of fabric featuring a floral pattern in red, blue, and light brown hues. The central section of the curtains, along with the bottom hem and the valance at the top, showcases these intricate floral designs, which include various flowers and foliage in shades of red, pink, blue, green, and tan, with black outlines. The bottom edge of the curtains and the valance also have a repeated geometric pattern in dark brown or black, blue, red, and cream, which includes oval and circular motifs. The composition includes pleats or folds in the main curtain panels, giving a sense of depth and texture, while one of the panels is drawn slightly back to reveal a lighter blue lining. The background of the drawing is plain, with no additional objects or setting details depicted.
title: Curtains
